title: (RHBA-2023:4818) s390utils bug fix update
portal_summary: An update for s390utils is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server - Extended Life Cycle Support (for IBM z Systems)|7|s390x
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM z Systems|7|s390x
portal_solution:
For details on how to apply this update, which includes the changes described
in this advisory, refer to

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be
used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es):

* ziomon fails when a disk with PQual=1 and Device_type=0 is present on the
system. (BZ#2178802)
